title: Transport a bounded coproduct comparison through proper windows
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, p:X→Y a scheme morphism, and d an integer. Write A_Z=Mod(Λ_Z), D_Z=D(A_Z), F=Rp_*, and Dic(Z) for degreewise ind-constructible objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects; sk-def-sfb-constructible; sk-lem-proper-unbounded-window]. Assume ProperUnboundedWindowAssertions Λ p d. Assume ambient coproducts of Dic objects remain in Dic on both schemes, and both canonical truncations preserve Dic on X. Assume every H^q:D_Y→A_Y sends colimit cofans of small families to colimit cocones. Assume τ≥r τ≤q:D_X→D_X sends colimit cofans to colimit cocones for all q,r. Finally, assume that for every pair a,b and small family of Dic(X) objects with homology vanishing below a and above b, there is a colimit cofan whose image under F is colimiting. Then for every small family K_i in Dic(X), there are colimit cofans c of K_i and c′ of F(K_i), with c.pt in Dic(X), c′.pt in Dic(Y), such that the canonical morphism c′.pt→F(c.pt) with components F(c.inj i) is invertible. All families are indexed in the site/coefficient universe.

proof.text: Choose the ambient coproduct cofans c and c′ using the derived coproduct existence theorem for Grothendieck module-object categories. The given sum-closure hypotheses and the window hypothesis put their vertices in Dic. Define the canonical comparison using the universal property of c′.

Fix q and put r=q−2d−1 and T=τ≥r τ≤q. Truncation stability puts all T K_i in Dic; the standard t-structure gives their common homology interval [r,q]. The assumed bounded-family comparison means F preserves this family’s coproduct. Preservation is independent of the chosen cofan, hence the images under F and then H^q of T(c) are colimiting.

Let L=τ≤q. The natural transformations L F H^q→F H^q and L F H^q→T F H^q have invertible components on every K_i and on c.pt, by the window hypothesis. A natural transformation with these invertible components transports a colimit cofan. Transport first backwards along the second transformation and then forwards along the first, proving H^q(F(c)) colimiting. Naturality on each coprojection verifies the cofan isomorphisms.

By the assumed homology preservation, H^q(c′) is also colimiting. The cofan universal property identifies H^q of the canonical comparison with the unique map between these two colimit cofans. It is therefore an isomorphism. Apply the cohomological isomorphism criterion for every q.

theorem properUnbounded_coproductComparison
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℤ)
    (hwindow : ProperUnboundedWindowAssertions Λ p d)
    (hsumX : ∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) (K : I → DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X))
      (c : Cofan K), IsColimit c →
      (∀ i n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj (K i))) →
      ∀ n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj c.pt))
    (hsumY : ∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) (K : I → DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ Y))
      (c : Cofan K), IsColimit c →
      (∀ i n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Y)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj (K i))) →
      ∀ n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Y)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj c.pt))
    (htrunc : ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X)) (n : ℤ),
      (∀ m, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ m).obj K)) →
      (∀ m, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ m).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE n).obj K))) ∧
      (∀ m, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ m).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n).obj K))))
    (hH : ∀ (I : Type (u + 1))
      (K : Discrete I ⥤ DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ Y)) (c : Cocone K),
      IsColimit c → ∀ q : ℤ,
        Nonempty (IsColimit ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapCocone c)))
    (hT : ∀ (I : Type (u + 1))
      (K : I → DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X)) (c : Cofan K),
      IsColimit c → ∀ q r : ℤ,
      Nonempty (IsColimit (((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE q) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE r).mapCocone c)))
    (hbounded : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (I : Type (u + 1))
      (K : I → DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X)),
      (∀ i n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj (K i))) →
      (∀ i n, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj (K i))) →
      ∃ (c : Cofan K) (_ : IsColimit c),
        Nonempty (IsColimit ((CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ p).rightDerivedFunctor.mapCocone c))) :
    ∀ (I : Type (u + 1))
      (K : I → DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X)),
    (∀ i n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj (K i))) →
    ∃ (c : Cofan K) (_ : IsColimit c)
      (c' : Cofan (fun i ↦ (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj (K i)))
      (hc' : IsColimit c'),
      (∀ n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj c.pt)) ∧
      (∀ n, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Y)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj c'.pt)) ∧
      IsIso (hc'.desc (Cofan.mk
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj c.pt)
        (fun i ↦ (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ p).rightDerivedFunctor.map (c.inj i))))
